query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.action_type, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.created_at, ua.duration_ms, au.name, au.email
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users au ON ua.app_user_id = au.id
WHERE au.email LIKE '%linas%' OR au.name LIKE '%Linas%'
ORDER BY ua.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
